deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Rollback initiated for service `inference-runtime` in prod-us-east1
- Trigger: Spike in 5xx rate on /v1/generate after deploy tag v1.7.2
- Action: Reverting to tag v1.7.1 (commit ab12cd3)
- Initiated by: oncall-sre
- Context: emergency rollback outside regular change window

maria: ack — I saw the dashboard alert. How much traffic was shifted during the canary?

kevin: saw ~12% 5xx at peak on the canary group (1:40am). Overall latency also increased ~150ms.

sophie: please pin v1.7.1 for prod until we finish triage. Also add a short release note that v1.7.2 caused 5xx spike.

oncall-sre: starting the revert deploy now. I'll kick it off via the deploy service and post progress.

deploy-bot: [deploy] Revert deploy started: `inference-runtime` -> v1.7.1 in prod-us-east1 (deploy id: db-2026-03-20-001)
- Rolling back 4 pods
- Rolling update strategy: Cordon + recreate
- Expected completion: ~2m

maria: copying logs to the incident channel. pasting the relevant tail: ```
2026-03-20T01:40:12Z inference-runtime ERROR handler: downstream timeout
2026-03-20T01:40:13Z inference-runtime ERROR kv-cache miss spike
```

kevin: confirmed. adding a quick diff: `diff --git a/config queue b/config queue` (noted increased concurrency setting in v1.7.2)

sophie: pin command suggestion: `redwood cli releases pin --service inference-runtime --env prod --tag v1.7.1 --until 2026-03-21T04:00Z`

oncall-sre: doing that now. will also open INC for postmortem.

deploy-bot: [deploy] Revert deploy completed: `inference-runtime` now at v1.7.1 in prod-us-east1 :white_check_mark:
- Deploy duration: 95s
- Pods Ready: 4/4
- Health checks: OK
- Auto-pin applied: v1.7.1 pinned for prod until 2026-03-21T04:00Z (policy: emergency-fallback)

kevin: good. can we mark the release as reverted in the release tracker and add the quick blame note `v1.7.2 -> revert (hotfix)`?

sophie: done — created INC-2026-042 and added rollback steps + logs + timeline. assigning triage to @kevin.

oncall-sre: I'll run the smoke script across regions: `./scripts/smoke.sh --env=prod --tag=v1.7.1` and watch metrics for 15m.

deploy-bot: [monitor] Alert cleared for /v1/generate 5xx spike. Baseline restored to pre-release levels.

maria: suggestion: add an automatic fallback policy to route small % of traffic to dedicated capacity when error rate >10% during rollout. filing a follow-up PR.

kevin: agreed, also schedule a quick postmortem tomorrow during change-window to discuss rollout gate improvements.

sophie: thanks everyone. I'll update the release notes and notify product about the revert.

oncall-sre: closing thread here once monitoring passes 30m. will re-open if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
